jobs.title: B2B Product Data Analyst
jobs.description: B2B Product Data Analyst ** W2 contract, min 12 months ** ONSITE out of Plano, TX ** Target W2 $42-46/hr Role And Responsibilities Create and execute product marketing plans for assigned products and customers by leveraging data-driven insights, predictive analytics, and automation using Alteryx, Tableau, and Excel. Support and Drive achievement of key product KPIs such as revenue, profitability, and market share objectives through continuous data modeling, statistical analysis, and reporting. Collaborate with Sales, CPFR, and Supply Chain teams to track forecast accuracy, identify demand fluctuations, and provide real-time insights through automated data pipelines. Own product lifecycle analytics for the B2B monitor portfolio: launch forecasting, ramp up tracking, and EOL demand modeling. You'll work weekly with Korea HQ on these calls. Maintain a weekly revenue tracker for key accounts, measuring attainment versus targets and providing insights through advanced data visualization techniques. Be the analytics contact for Tier 1 distributors (Ingram Micro, D&H). Pull weekly sell through, POS, and inventory data into one clean reporting layer. Analyze business processes, identify inefficiencies, and apply data science methodologies to enhance operational efficiency while presenting findings in clear, concise formats such as charts, graphs, and tables. Build automated checks that flag when distributor reported numbers don't match internal ERP data. Escalate the real discrepancies. Establish efficient methods for recording, tracking, and reporting business activity, leveraging automation for large-scale enterprise data ETL processes with Alteryx. Modify and maintain databases, ensuring data integrity and scalability while implementing predictive data models and directing programmers and analysts on necessary system enhancements. Manage market share forecasting for B2B. Skills and Qualifications: Top skills: Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Predictive Modeling Bachelor's in Information Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar. 2+ years in a data analytics or quantitative role. Consumer electronics or hardware background preferred. Strong with Alteryx for building data pipelines. Strong with Tableau to create various dashboards. Comfortable using AI Tools and agents for atomization Advanced Excel: nested formulas, Power Query, VBA.

jobs.title: Data Engineer I (Onsite)
jobs.description: Job Details: The IT Data Engineer I builds foundational skills in SQL, Python, and data pipeline development. Working under direct supervision, this role supports data ingestion, transformation, and quality processes while developing awareness of cloud platforms, data governance, and AI-assisted development tools. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Delivers low-complexity data engineering tasks as part of a team. Works under direct supervision; receives instructions, guidance, and direction from others. Scope: Team. Develop and maintain SQL-based data pipelines, ensuring efficient ETL processes. Write Python scripts to support data transformation, ingestion, and automation tasks. Develop foundational skills in working with common data serialization and interchange formats (e.g., JSON, CSV, Parquet, Avro) for data ingestion and transformation. Learn and apply foundational concepts of data warehousing, data architecture, and basic data modeling (e.g., fact/dimension tables, normalization). Assist in applying data classification standards to datasets and pipelines under guidance, learning to identify data sensitivity levels (e.g., public, internal, confidential, restricted). Provide assistance in data governance, data quality, and data privacy activities, including following PII handling protocols and data retention policies. Escalate potential data exposure or classification issues to senior engineers. Use version control systems (e.g., Git) for all code and configuration changes, including branching, committing, and participating in pull requests. Gain foundational exposure to major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and understand how data services operate in a cloud environment. Develop basic awareness of containerization concepts and how pipelines are packaged and deployed. Learn basic data testing and validation practices using data quality frameworks to ensure pipeline output quality. Assist in implementing basic logging and monitoring for data pipelines to support troubleshooting and operational visibility. Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand requirements for data solutions. AI-Assisted Engineering Develop a foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts and their application to data pipelines and automation. Learn to use AI-assisted tools and copilots to accelerate data engineering tasks such as code generation, debugging, and documentation. Gain exposure to prompt engineering fundamentals and how large language models (LLMs) can support data operations. Understand that AI-generated outputs can be inaccurate; learn to validate and verify AI-produced code, queries, and results before use. Qualifications Education: Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience. Preferred Certification(s): Any relevant IT Certification (e.g., AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital Leader, Azure Fundamentals, Databricks Lakehouse Fundamentals). Experience: Less than one year of relevant or practical experience. Special Skills Proficiency in SQL and foundational Python scripting. Understanding of data warehousing concepts, basic data modeling, and basic data architecture. Familiarity with common data serialization and interchange formats. Foundational exposure to modern cloud data platforms and at least one major cloud platform (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure). Basic proficiency with version control systems for collaborative development. Basic awareness of AI/ML concepts and AI-assisted development tools for code generation and data analysis. Soft Skills Curiosity: Eagerness to explore and understand new data concepts, AI technologies, and emerging patterns. Receptiveness to Feedback: Willingness to accept and act on coaching from senior engineers. Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data handling and analysis. Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Communication: Clear and concise communication of technical concepts. Reliability: Consistently meeting deadlines and following through on commitments. Adaptability: Willingness to learn new technologies, including AI-driven tools, and adapt to change. Not eligible for immigration/work authorization support now or in the future * * Not eligible for relocation assista nce * All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. Individual Contributors should demonstrate the ability to integrate AI into daily work, improve efficiency through AI-enabled solutions, evaluate outputs critically, and apply professional judgment when using AI. People Leaders should demonstrate the ability to drive responsible AI adoption, enable effective use of approved solutions, identify opportunities to improve team performance through AI, and ensure accountability for the quality and accuracy of AI-supported outcomes. jobs.title: Databricks Engineer - Data Engineer II
jobs.description: Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $97,700 to $162,800.
